section.content: The utility model provides machine learning equipment based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a base, universal wheels are arranged at the corners of the bottom end of the base, a bearing platform is arranged above the base, lifting structures are arranged at the corners of the bottom end of the bearing platform, the lifting structures are connected with the base, a power cavity is arranged in the middle of the top end of the bearing platform, a through hole is arranged in the middle of the bearing platform, hemispherical first shock absorbers are evenly arranged on the inner wall of the through hole, second shock absorbers with big ends and small middle are arranged in the space enclosed by the first shock absorbers, the top ends of the second shock absorbers are exposed out of the through hole and are fixedly connected with the middle position of the bottom end of the power cavity, and the bottom end of the second damping body is exposed out of the through hole and fixedly connected with a horizontal limiting plate, the top end of the horizontal limiting plate is uniformly provided with vertical columns penetrating through the bearing table around the second damping body, the top end of each vertical column is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the power cavity, and a first damping spring is sleeved above and below the bearing table on each vertical column. The utility model discloses play fine cushioning effect to the power cavity.

本实用新型提供了一种基于人工智能的机器学习设备，包括基座，基座底端拐角处皆设有万向轮，基座上方设有承载台，承载台底端拐角处皆设有升降结构，升降结构皆与基座连接，承载台顶端居中设有动力腔体，承载台上居中设置通孔，通孔内壁上均匀设置半球形的第一减震体，第一减震体围成的空间内设置有两端大中间小的第二减震体，第二减震体顶端外露出通孔外并与动力腔体底端居中的位置固连，且第二减震体底端外露出通孔外并固连有水平限位板，水平限位板顶端围绕第二减震体均匀设有贯穿承载台的竖直柱，每一竖直柱顶端均与动力腔体底端固连，且每一竖直柱上位于承载台的上方和下方均套设有第一减震弹簧。本实用新型对动力腔体起到很好的减震作用。

Machine learning equipment based on artificial intelligenceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to machine learning technical field especially involves a machine learning equipment based on artificial intelligence.

Background

When manufacturing machines such as machine tools and robots are developed, in order to improve the reliability of the manufacturing machines, recognition processing is required to classify and store the manufacturing machines for people to inquire, and corresponding machine learning equipment is required to improve the efficiency of recognition and classification storage. Machine learning is a multi-field interdiscipline, is based on the core of artificial intelligence, and is a fundamental way for a computer to have intelligence; in machine learning, machine vision is an important research field, and the machine vision is characterized by improving the automation degree of production, for example, in some dangerous working environments, machine vision is used to replace artificial vision.

This type of machine learning equipment based on artificial intelligence on market is various nowadays, can satisfy people's user demand basically, for example china utility model discloses a machine learning device (the publication number is CN210295150U) for image classification and discernment, it solves the problem of the adjusting distance of being not convenient for between plummer and the base through elevation structure, play the protective effect to the touch screen through the guard plate, and play dustproof effect to the power cavity through the dust screen, nevertheless because the power cavity has set up the analysis appearance, electrical component such as memory and singlechip, and above-mentioned utility model does not consider the shock attenuation problem, the electrical component who sets up in the power cavity damages because of vibrations easily, consequently, it is necessary to further improve.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims at overcoming the not enough of prior art, provide a machine learning equipment based on artificial intelligence.

The utility model discloses a realize through following technical scheme:

the utility model provides an artificial intelligence-based machine learning device, which comprises a base, universal wheels are arranged at the corners of the bottom end of the base, a bearing platform is arranged above the base, lifting structures are arranged at the corners of the bottom end of the bearing platform, the lifting structures are connected with the base, a power cavity is arranged at the top end of the bearing platform in the middle, a through hole is arranged at the bearing platform in the middle, hemispherical first shock absorbers are evenly arranged on the inner wall of the through hole, second shock absorbers with big ends and small middle parts are arranged in the space enclosed by the first shock absorbers, the top ends of the second shock absorbers are exposed out of the through hole and are fixedly connected with the middle position of the bottom end of the power cavity, and the bottom ends of the second shock absorbers are exposed out of the through hole and fixedly connected with a horizontal limiting plate, the top ends of the horizontal limiting plate surround the second shock absorbers and are evenly provided with vertical columns penetrating through the bearing platform, each vertical top of the column all with the power cavity bottom links firmly, and each vertical post is located all the cover is equipped with first damping spring in the top and the below of plummer.

Preferably, the first shock absorber and the second shock absorber are both silica gel bodies.

Preferably, horizontal extension plates are respectively arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the power cavity, vertical limiting columns which correspondingly penetrate through the two horizontal extension plates are respectively arranged on two sides of the top end of the bearing table, and a limiting head is arranged at the top end of each vertical limiting column.

Preferably, each vertical limiting column is sleeved with a second damping spring above and below the corresponding penetrating horizontal extension plate.

Preferably, the vertical limiting columns on two sides of the top end of the bearing table are symmetrically arranged in a plurality respectively.

Preferably, the horizontal limiting plate is located between the lifting structures.

In the above embodiment, the utility model discloses an improve the connection between power cavity and the plummer, through the first shock attenuation body and the second shock attenuation body that set up in the through-hole on the plummer and the second shock attenuation spring on first shock attenuation spring on the vertical post and the vertical spacing post, can play a fine cushioning effect to the power cavity, help avoiding the electric elements on the inside and surface of power cavity to damage because of vibrations.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a schematic structural diagram of an artificial intelligence based machine learning apparatus provided by an embodiment of the present invention;

fig. 2 is a schematic sectional view of the connection between the power cavity and the bearing table provided in the embodiment of the present invention;

fig. 3 is a partial enlarged view of a portion a in fig. 2 according to an embodiment of the present invention;

fig. 4 is a partial enlarged view of a portion B in fig. 2 according to an embodiment of the present invention.

In the figure: 1-a base; 2-universal wheels; 3-a bearing platform; 4-a bearing platform; 5-a power cavity; 6-through holes; 7-a first shock absorber; 8-a second shock absorber; 9-horizontal limiting plate; 10-vertical columns; 11-a first damping spring; 12-a horizontally extending plate; 13-vertical spacing posts; 14-a limiting head; 15-second damping spring.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the present invention more clearly understood, the present invention is further described in detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings and embodiments. It should be understood that the specific embodiments described herein are merely illustrative of the invention and are not intended to limit the invention.

For the convenience of understanding the machine learning device based on artificial intelligence provided by the embodiment of the present invention, the following description is made in detail with reference to the accompanying drawings and specific embodiments.

Referring to fig. 1, fig. 1 is a schematic structural diagram of an artificial intelligence based machine learning apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention.

As shown in fig. 1, this machine learning equipment based on artificial intelligence includes base 1, and 1 bottom corner of base all is equipped with universal wheel 2, and 1 top of base is equipped with plummer 3, and 3 bottom corners of plummer all are equipped with elevation structure 4, and elevation structure 4 all is connected with base 1, and 3 tops of plummer are equipped with power cavity 5 between two parties.

Above-mentioned base 1, universal wheel 2, plummer 3, elevation structure 4 and power cavity 5 mentioned all unanimous with prior art, the utility model discloses lie in with the prior art difference: connection mode between plummer 3 and the power cavity 5 is different, adopts the utility model discloses technical scheme can realize the shock attenuation effect to power cavity 5.

The differences between the present invention and the prior art will be described in detail with reference to fig. 2-4. Fig. 2 is a schematic diagram of a cross-sectional structure of the power cavity and the plummer provided by the embodiment of the present invention, fig. 3 is a partial enlarged view of a position a in fig. 2 provided by the embodiment of the present invention, and fig. 4 is a partial enlarged view of a position B in fig. 2 provided by the embodiment of the present invention.

As shown in fig. 2-4, a through hole 6 is arranged in the middle of the bearing table 3, a hemispherical first damping body 7 is evenly arranged on the inner wall of the through hole 6, the first damping body 7 is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the through hole 6, a second damping body 8 with two large ends and small middle is arranged in a space surrounded by the first damping body 7, the top end of the second damping body 8 is exposed out of the through hole 6 and fixedly connected with the middle position of the bottom end of the power cavity 5, and the bottom end of the second damping body 8 is exposed out of the through hole 6 and fixedly connected with a horizontal limiting plate 9.

The utility model discloses in, second damper 8 is the little sketch body in the big centre in both ends to with the space size looks adaptation that a plurality of first dampers 7 enclose. The first damper 7 and the second damper 8 are both colloidal silica. The horizontal limiting plate 9 is positioned between the lifting structures 4 at the four corners. The horizontal limiting plate 9 is parallel to the bearing table 3, the horizontal limiting plate 9 can be a circular plate concentrically arranged with the second shock absorption body 8, the diameter of the circular plate is larger than the maximum diameter of the second shock absorption body 8, and the maximum diameter of the second shock absorption body 8 is matched with the inner diameter of the through hole 6.

Further, 9 tops of horizontal limiting plate evenly are equipped with the vertical post 10 that runs through plummer 3 around second shock absorber 8, and vertical post 10 runs through plummer 3 setting perpendicularly, and each vertical post 10 bottom all links firmly with 9 top limit portions of horizontal limiting plate, and each vertical post 10 top all links firmly with 5 bottoms of power cavity to the top and the below that lie in plummer 3 on each vertical post 10 all overlap and are equipped with first damping spring 11. The platform 3 is provided with a first through hole (not shown) for each vertical column 10 to correspondingly pass through.

With continued reference to fig. 2-4, two horizontal extension plates 12 are respectively disposed on two sides of the bottom end of the power cavity 5, the two horizontal extension plates 12 are respectively and fixedly connected with two sides of the bottom end of the power cavity 5, and the two horizontal extension plates 12 are both disposed parallel to the bearing platform 3. The two sides of the top end of the bearing table 3 are respectively provided with a vertical limiting column 13 correspondingly penetrating through the two horizontal extending plates 12, and the top end of each vertical limiting column 13 is provided with a limiting head 14.

Specifically, each vertical spacing post 13 is perpendicular to the bearing platform 3 and is arranged, the bottom end of each vertical spacing post 13 is fixedly connected with the bearing platform 3, and the spacing head 14 at the top end of each vertical spacing post 13 is connected with the top end of the vertical spacing post 13 in a fixedly connecting mode. In addition, a second damping spring 15 is respectively sleeved on each vertical limiting column 13 above and below the corresponding penetrating horizontal extension plate 12.

The utility model discloses in, the vertical spacing post 13 of 3 top both sides of plummer symmetry respectively sets up a plurality ofly. Each horizontal extension plate 12 is provided with a second through hole (not shown) for each vertical limiting column 13 on the corresponding side to correspondingly penetrate.

The utility model discloses an improve the connection between power cavity 5 and the plummer 3, through the first damper 7 and the second damper 8 that set up in the through-hole 6 on the plummer 3 and the second damper 15 on first damper 11 and the vertical spacing post 13 on the vertical post 10, can play a fine cushioning effect to power cavity 5, help avoiding the electric elements on the inside and surface of power cavity 5 to damage because of vibrations.

The above description is only exemplary of the present invention and should not be construed as limiting the present invention, and any modifications, equivalents and improvements made within the spirit and principles of the present invention are intended to be included within the scope of the present invention.
